build_doc_classification_module: build a PyTorch Lightning module for document classification with configurable transform, model, and optimizer
create_from_config: create a DocClassificationModule instance from Hydra DictConfig for transform, model, and optimizer
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the transform and model to get classification logits from token IDs
test_training_step: test the training step that computes cross-entropy loss and logs train_loss metrics
review_validation_step: review the validation step that computes accuracy and F1 score metrics on validation data
